relations.rationale: Both describe Eli's standing relative to others but concern different people, so they neither confirm nor conflict.
Eli standing above Zeno is unrelated to Zeno's age ranking among the group.
Standing height/position has no bearing on the group's decision to pick up pace.
Eli's height relative to Zeno has no bearing on everyone stopping to watch a hawk.
Eli's height relative to Dara is unrelated to team membership.
Height comparisons between Eli and Dara are unrelated to age comparisons between Zeno and Dara.
Eli's height relative to Dara has nothing to do with the trail's terrain description.
Height comparison is unrelated to Zeno spotting a hawk.
Mina being on Eli's team is consistent with but doesn't determine Eli's team relative to Zeno's, though combined with other facts it could support; alone it's neutral.
If Mina is on the same team as Eli, and Eli is not on Zeno's team (per other claims, but only using these two), this alone doesn't establish Mina's relation to Zeno's team.
Team membership is unrelated to Dara setting up a camp stove.
The second claim explains the context in which the first fact was discovered, directly supporting its truth.
Nell's racing rank is unrelated to Zeno spotting a hawk.
Comparing race bibs is unrelated to settling in for the night under the stars.
Zeno being the oldest supports the claim that he is older than Dara, consistent with a small age gap.
Zeno's age ranking has no bearing on the group stopping to watch a hawk.
Age difference between Zeno and Dara is unrelated to the group's decision to increase pace.
Eli not being on Zeno's team is unrelated to whether Mina is on Zeno's team.
Team membership between Eli and Zeno is unrelated to Dara setting up a camp stove.
The trail leading to the rocky overlook supports the later claim that the group paused there for lunch.
